Reference / runtime/template

runtime/template#

The native layer under the template modules: the calls they make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under the template modules: the calls they make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime. The template compiler natives were removed in #13: the scanner is Okkama (template/compile).

Public API#

native template_output_size#

native template_output_size(origin is string, maximum_bytes is int) is int

UTF-8 byte count without allocating an encoded byte array. Returns -1 when text cannot fit maximum_bytes; negative budgets and non-scalars fail natively.
